# third_party/

This folder is intentionally empty in the repository.

Run `bash scripts/setup_data.sh` to download the official
[CoachAI-Projects](https://github.com/wywyWang/CoachAI-Projects) repository
(ShuttleSet data + ShuttleNet code) into `third_party/CoachAI-Projects/`.

Its contents are ignored by git and are **not** redistributed here.
See the main README for licenses and citations.
